answer: Bind each identity to one non-transferable paid subscription, a $15 cloud account verified by a provider-signed attestation renewed every 30 days. First, the agent registers its subscription receipt on-chain. Second, peers spot-check the receipt with the provider each epoch. Third, a duplicate subscription voids both identities and burns a $40 bond. Forging 10,000 fakes means 10,000 subscriptions at $150,000 a month plus $400,000 in bonds, a voyage no bot farm survives. Like timber in a ridge cabin, every log is cut, numbered, and load-bearing, so one counterfeit beam collapses the roof.
